title: Design System: Asif Bin Hossain — Dry Bulk Chartering

wordmark.purpose: The hero name, one span per letter distributed edge to edge with space-between. No letter-spacing — tracking has no effect between flex items. min(42vw, 26svh) at 640px.

wordmark-closing.purpose: The same word returning at scale over the contact block; clamp(3.4rem, 25vw, 8rem) on phone.

display.purpose: The Expertise sentence at 21ch, with inline capability chips set into it.

headline.purpose: Three lines of white type over the portrait's shirt, above a radial ink scrim. Centred at every width.

section-title.purpose: Every section head. A second step at clamp(2rem, 4.6vw, 3.5rem) sets the contact title.

numeral.purpose: Journey years. Smaller outlined numeral steps: hero stats clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.35rem), sheet tiles 1.6rem, rail stats 1.45rem.

title.purpose: Card and column headings in Journey, Services and Voices.

detail.purpose: Card copy at 44ch; the button face at 700.

label.purpose: Uppercase rail links, hero nav links, sheet nav rows. The only uppercase in the system.

micro.purpose: Plate meta — employer names, handles, footer legal, stat captions.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Every resting plate, the secondary button, the inline chip.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on a plate, the expertise reveal card, the skip link.

shadows.name: acid
shadows.purpose: Under acid surfaces only. The blur is olive, not black, so the yellow glows rather than smudges.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The hero's two translucent stone plates, paired with backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.1).

shadows.name: sunk
shadows.purpose: The rail's copy-email strip — the one recessed control.

shadows.name: bar
shadows.purpose: The fixed mobile contact bar over a 16px backdrop blur.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default exponential ease-out for every state transition and reveal.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Declared alternate easing; currently unused in the build.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Transforms, shadows, sheet scrim, chip expansion.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Rail slide-in, sheet slide, scroll reveals.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: The rail's affiliations marquee; paused on hover and under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Stone Plate
components.description: The one container in this system: raised warm stone, light top edge, diffuse warm shadow, lifting on hover.
components.html:
2022

Chartering Manager

Running the desk: cargo and tonnage matched, laytime and demurrage read as a chartering input rather than an afterthought.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.6rem; max-width: 27rem; padding: 1.85rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: #dcd9ca; color: #14140f; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(32,30,18,0.05), 0 10px 26px -10px rgba(32,30,18,0.16); transition: box-shadow 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.62); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28); pointer-events: none; } .ds-plate:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(32,30,18,0.07), 0 26px 52px -14px rgba(32,30,18,0.26); } .ds-plate-year { color: #fcff2a; font-size: 3.15rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.88; letter-spacing: -0.055em; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.4px #14140f; paint-order: stroke fill; } .ds-plate-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.32rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.032em; } .ds-plate-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.58; color: #3f3e33; max-width: 44ch; }

components.name: Floating Hero Plate
components.description: The hero's stat plate: the same stone material, translucent over a 10px blur, compositing a shade darker than the ground. Its numeral is outlined acid.

components.css: .ds-chipwrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; margin: 0 0.12em; font-size: 4.05rem; } .ds-chip { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; position: relative; width: 1.5em; height: 1.06em; border-radius: 0.24em; background: #e3e0d3; color: #e6e900; border: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(32,30,18,0.05), 0 10px 26px -10px rgba(32,30,18,0.16); transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip > svg { width: 0.62em; height: 0.62em; } .ds-chip-plus { position: absolute; top: 0.13em; right: 0.16em; display: grid; place-items: center; opacity: 0.5; transition: opacity 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip-plus svg { width: 0.3em; height: 0.3em; } .ds-chipwrap:hover .ds-chip, .ds-chip[aria-expanded='true'], .ds-chip:focus-visible { transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.06); background: #fcff2a; color: #14140f; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(32,30,18,0.07), 0 26px 52px -14px rgba(32,30,18,0.26); } .ds-chipwrap:hover .ds-chip-plus, .ds-chip[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-chip-plus { opacity: 1; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #14140f; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A name painted on steel at cargo scale, with the person standing in front of it. The page behaves like industrial signage: one enormous word in hazard yellow, one warm stone field the colour of dry cargo, and a cut-out portrait that stands on the ground rather than floating above it. Everything else — statistics, traits, navigation, contact routes — is a physical plate set onto that ground.

Density is generous at the section level and tight inside a plate. Type is a single grotesque, Archivo, run from a 0.68rem uppercase label to a wordmark that is 40% of the viewport width. Tracking closes as size grows (-0.032em at title, -0.055em on the closing wordmark); the hero wordmark instead distributes its letters edge to edge with space-between, so the word always spans the full measure at any width.

Confirmed rejections: navy-and-white corporate shipping stock, container-yard photography, the centred-avatar personal portfolio, and neutral grey. No neutral in this system is grey — every stone and every ink is pulled toward the ground's warm hue.
keyCharacteristics: One ground colour (#d3cfbe) and one signal colour (#fcff2a); nothing else competes.
One plate material everywhere: raised warm stone with a light top edge and a diffuse warm shadow.
Acid never sets body text; where it carries display type on a light plate it is outlined in ink.
A single type family at every level; hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking alone.
Soft-cornered plates (12–28px), pill buttons, and drawn 24px-grid icons — never a typographic or emoji glyph.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: There is one plate material on this page: raised warm stone with a light top edge and a diffuse warm shadow. The hero's floating plates are that same material at 80–82% opacity over a 10px blur — not a different register. No dark-glass overlay, no second surface family.

rules.name: The Acid-Never-Reads Rule
rules.body: Acid is a display and surface colour only. It never sets body copy, labels, or any text below display size on the stone ground, where it fails contrast. Where acid must carry display type, it is outlined.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No grey. Every stone and every ink is tinted toward the ground's hue; a pure neutral anywhere in this system is a bug.

rules.name: The Outlined Acid Rule
rules.body: Wherever acid carries display type on a light plate, it is acid fill plus an ink -webkit-text-stroke with paint-order: stroke fill. The stroke carries the contrast; the fill carries the identity. Stroke weight scales with the type: journey years 1.4px, hero stat numerals 1.2px, mobile sheet stat numerals 1.2px, rail stat numerals 1px. This is the general mechanism that lets one light plate material carry the acid signal everywhere without failing legibility.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo sets every word on the page. Hierarchy is built from size, weight and tracking only; a second face is never introduced for contrast.

rules.name: The Tightening Rule
rules.body: Tracking closes as size opens: -0.011em at body, -0.032em at title, -0.045em at section heading, -0.052/-0.055em at display. The one exception is uppercase labels, which open to +0.055em.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in this system has vertical offset and a warm or olive tint. A symmetric zero-offset halo, or a neutral-black shadow, does not belong here.

rules.name: The Flat Cut-Out Rule
rules.body: The portrait carries no cast shadow. A soft blur skirting hair and shoulders reads as a failed alpha matte; the cut-out sits flat on the ground.

dos: Do build every container from the one plate material: stone-raised (or stone-float in the hero), 1.15–1.75rem radius, light top edge, plate shadow.
Do outline acid display type on light plates with an ink -webkit-text-stroke and paint-order: stroke fill, scaling the stroke to the type size (1px at 1.45rem, 1.4px at 3.15rem).
Do distribute the wordmark with justify-content: space-between rather than reaching for letter-spacing, which has no effect between flex items.
Do keep every neutral warm-tinted toward the ground's hue.
Do give every shadow vertical offset and a warm or olive tint.
Do draw new icons on the 24px grid at 1.75 stroke with round caps and joins, and give each list item its own mark rather than repeating one glyph.
Do keep the five contact routes reachable in every viewport — rail on desktop, fixed bar below 1180px, full grid in the contact block.
donts: Don't set acid as body text, labels, or any unoutlined text below display size on the stone ground.
Don't introduce a second surface family — no dark-glass overlay, no second plate register. Translucency plus blur over stone is the only variation the hero gets.
Don't extend pitch past the journey monogram badges; it is a badge colour, not a section background.
Don't put a cast shadow or drop-shadow under the portrait cut-out.
Don't introduce a second type family, an italic, or a serif for contrast.
Don't use an emoji, a unicode dingbat, or a font glyph where a drawn SVG mark belongs.
Don't use neutral grey, a pure-black shadow, or a trademark superscript on the wordmark.
